answer: A concrete defense is device-rooted identity: each agent's keypair must be certified by a unique hardware enclave attestation. Minting fake identities in software is free, but every one needs a distinct physical device, so a sybil farm pays a hard real-world cost per fake. Genuine activity is a tide that rises and falls with actual compute; forged identities cannot ride it because their attestation stock runs dry. The ledger keeps an ivory list of verified device roots and a sable list of revoked ones, tying reputation to hardware reality instead of duplicable software tokens.
